text.description_html:
Stainless Steel Barn Door Kit With 108" Track

This Modern Stainless Steel Barn Door Kit comes with everything you need to install a sliding door weighing up to 200 pounds. It comes packaged with a 108-inch track that is suitable for hanging a single wood door. Along with the anti-jump design that will keep the sliding door from easily falling off the track, the SIG500C kit includes a stainless steel ball bearing wheel assembly to ensure an ultra-smooth, nearly silent operation. This sliding door mounting kit has a satin stainless steel finish that will add a contemporary touch to your home. And since it is made out of stainless steel, you can be certain it is designed to withstand the test of time, just like the unfailing appeal of the barn door itself.

Features of the Sliding Barn Door Installation Kit:

  • Comes with all necessary hardware.
  • All stainless steel construction.
  • Nylon covered wheel for silent operation.
  • Ball bering wheel for a long lasting, smooth operation.
  • Anti-jump wall mounting brackets.
  • The track-mounted door stops have rubber bumpers so they will not damage the doors.

Specifications of the Modern Stainless Steel Barn Door Kit with 108" Track:

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Track: 108" (9 feet)
  • For wood doors up to 200 LBS.
  • Door Thickness Minimum: 1-3/16"
  • AHI SIG500 Specifications Diagram (PDF)
  • AHI SIG500 Installation Guide (PDF)

Package Includes:

  • 1 Stainless Steel 108" Tubular Track
  • 2 Stainless Steel Roller Assemblies
  • 5 Stainless Steel Wall Mounts
  • 2 Stainless Steel Track End Caps
  • 2 Stainless Steel Door Stops
  • 1 Stainless Steel Floor Mounted Door Guide
  • All necessary installation hardware.

In case of a larger doorway, custom length tracks up to 10 feet are available. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.
